# § 9



The present tense includes the past and future tenses, and the future, the present. (Enacted by Stats. 1992, Ch. 162, Sec. 10. Operative January 1, 1994.) <input type="hidden" name="javax.faces.ViewState" id="j_id1:javax.faces.ViewState:7" value="
